summary_en: 920,000 shares (3.06% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on June 25, 2026 at upper limit ¥199.64M. Single-day execution at market open; order conditional on available sell orders matching the quantity. Settlement follows execution within the same trading window.
title_en: Notice regarding purchase of treasury shares via off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: MBK Co., Ltd. announces a single-block share repurchase executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market trading) on June 25, 2026. The board has authorized acquisition of up to 920,000 ordinary shares (3.06% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at an upper limit of ¥199.64M. The purchase order will be placed at market open (8:45 AM JST) on June 25, 2026, and is conditional on matching sell orders; if insufficient sell orders exist, the full 920,000-share quantity may not be acquired. The closing price on June 24, 2026 was ¥217 per share. Results will be published immediately after the trading window closes. This block purchase is part of a larger authorization: the December 12, 2025 and May 18, 2026 board meetings approved acquisition of up to 4.1M shares (13.37% of S/O) for up to ¥820M over the period January 30 – December 11, 2026. As of June 24, 2026, MBK had cumulatively acquired 2.618M shares for ¥591.34M under this authorization.
